title: ZeroTier and Carahsoft Partner to Bring Post-Quantum Software-Defined Networking to the Public Sector - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Software-defined networking vendor ZeroTier named Carahsoft its Master Government Aggregator, putting ZeroTier Quantum onto NASA SEWP V contract vehicles for U.S. public sector and defense buyers. The product embeds hybrid ML-KEM-1024 plus ECDH P-384 key exchange into the transport layer via a Rust-based ZeroTier Transport Protocol, pitched as a way to wrap legacy assets and edge platforms in post-quantum encryption without replacing hardware.

insights.claim: Carahsoft Technology Corp. will act as ZeroTier's Master Government Aggregator, distributing ZeroTier Quantum through its reseller network and the NASA Solutions for Enterprise-Wide Procurement (SEWP V) vehicles NNG15SC03B and NNG15SC27B.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: SEWP V listing removes the procurement friction that usually blocks small security vendors from federal budgets — the practical gate to revenue.
insights.locator: Opening paragraph — "Under the agreement, Carahsoft will serve as"

insights.claim: Post-quantum networking is being sold to U.S. public sector and defense agencies through incumbent government IT aggregators rather than direct enterprise sales.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: The aggregator channel is where post-quantum migration spend will first show up — watch Carahsoft's PQC vendor roster as a demand proxy.
insights.locator: Opening paragraph — "have entered into a strategic partnership"

themes.theme: Hybrid PQC in the transport layer

insights.claim: ZeroTier Quantum embeds post-quantum cryptographic resilience directly into the transport layer via the ZeroTier Transport Protocol, built on a memory-safe Rust architecture.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Transport-layer PQC means applications need no rewrite — the lowest-friction migration path and therefore the likeliest to be bought.

insights.claim: The platform implements a hybrid key exchange combining NIST-standardized ML-KEM-1024 module-lattice key encapsulation with classical ECDH P-384 elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Hybrid classical-plus-lattice is the pattern regulators are converging on; vendors shipping only one side will need re-engineering.
insights.locator: "the software overlay implements a hybrid ML-KEM-1024"

insights.claim: The hybrid design is positioned to defend against "Harvest Now, Decrypt Later" interdictions and to satisfy NSA Commercial National Security Algorithm Suite 2.0 timelines and NIST post-quantum migration mandates.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: CNSA 2.0 deadlines are the compliance clock forcing federal PQC purchases regardless of whether a cryptographically relevant quantum computer exists yet.
insights.quote: This hybrid model protects against “Harvest Now, Decrypt Later” (HNDL) interdictions and satisfies National Security Agency Commercial National Security Algorithm Suite 2.0 (NSA CNSA 2.0) timelines and NIST post-quantum migration mandates.

themes.theme: Overlay strategy for legacy and edge assets

insights.claim: As an infrastructure-agnostic overlay, ZeroTier Quantum lets agencies wrap legacy infrastructure and High Value Assets in a post-quantum encrypted mesh without replacing underlying hardware or re-architecting network routes.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Overlay-not-replace is the commercial unlock for PQC in government, where hardware refresh cycles run a decade or more.
insights.quote: in a post-quantum encrypted mesh without needing to replace underlying hardware or re-architect underlying network routes

insights.claim: The platform targets edge platforms including uncrewed aerial vehicles, tactical sensors and software-defined vehicles, and operates across multi-cloud, sovereign, air-gapped and offline environments while providing Zero Trust network access and data sovereignty.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Air-gapped and tactical support widens the addressable federal footprint beyond typical cloud-only ZTNA vendors.
insights.locator: "The software functions across multi-cloud, sovereign, air-gapped"
